scripts/binary_verify.py

Python · Tier B

Check release artifact hashes and optionally refresh sidecar checksums.

Usage

python scripts/binary_verify.py RELEASE_DIRECTORY [--refresh-checksums].

Inputs

manifest.json, SHA256SUMS and named artifacts in one release directory.

Side effects

Reads and hashes release files; rejects mismatched hashes/sizes or non-basename paths. --refresh-checksums rewrites SHA256SUMS after artifact verification; it does not sign.

Cleanup

No temporary processes or directories; existing release files remain in place.

@see scripts/binary_builder.py

@see docs/binary-distribution.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
verify 23 Verify manifest artifacts and complete sidecar checksum coverage in a release tree. Reject unsafe paths, duplicate entries and hash/size mismatches. When refresh is requested, rewrite SHA256SUMS only after verifying the manifest artifacts.
